Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Child of Cain, be afraid but keep hope!

The old wolf is dead and the nights to come will be longer and colder. Our societies very foundations have been weakened by his death. More than ever, it is time to unite to survive the lonely chilling nights.

To uphold the Parisian tradition, a great gathering will take place on saturday, February 12 in Paris. Bring your henchmen with you and your children along, as well as your pool and your cards. The Cup of Paris awaits the mightiest or more cunning vampire that will conquer it and keep it...

La Coupe de Paris 2011
2011, Feb. 12
in Troll2Jeux, 22 rue Hector Malot, 75012 PARIS, +33 01 43 40 90 46
Subway: Gare de Lyon

Fee: 5 €

Registration from 10:30 to 10:50
First round starts at 11 A.M.

30 players capacity.

Registration here or by mail to

Decklists and opaque sleeves strongly expected.

Coffee will be offered.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
